title: zombiesbetter
description: A survival-enhancing mod that gives zombies the ability to mine blocks, build stairs, and use specialist tools to reach the player. No more hiding behind walls!
body:
🧟 About ZombiesBetter
ZombiesBetter is a lightweight but challenging mod that transforms Minecraft zombies into intelligent, wall-breaking threats. If you think you're safe inside your house or deep in a mine, think again! These zombies will track you down and tear down any obstacle in their way.

🛠️ Key Features:
Intelligent Mining: Zombies can now detect players through walls within a 20-block radius and will actively mine blocks to reach them.

Staircase Building: If you are above them, zombies will mine in a "staircase" pattern to climb up and find you.

Specialist Classes: Zombies spawn with specific tools, making them experts at destroying certain blocks:

Pickaxe Zombie: Destroys stone and ores extremely fast. (Slower on dirt).

Axe Zombie: Quickly tears down wooden doors and planks.

Shovel Zombie: Clears dirt, sand, and gravel in seconds.

X-Ray Vision: Zombies are no longer fooled by simple walls. They know exactly where you are and will dig towards your coordinates.

Enchanted Gear: There is a 5% chance for a zombie to spawn with an Enchanted Efficiency tool, making them mine significantly faster!

⚙️ How it Works:
Zombies will prioritize mining blocks at head level first to create a path, followed by foot level. If the player is significantly lower, they will dig straight down. They maintain original zombie movement speeds for a balanced but terrifying experience.
